thread:
Leo (Billing): Quick heads up — saw a handful of customers charged extra when they crossed the soft tier threshold. Looks like the grace window wasn't applied in the snapshot job :thinking_face:
Eve (Docs): Oh no. Is that the nightly billing snapshot or the realtime usage export?
Leo (Billing): Nightly snapshot. The webhook export still showed expected values. Billing delta only in the snapshot that drives invoice preview.
Ravi (Backend): Can you paste the sample payload? Might be a rounding/aggregation bug.
Leo (Billing): Sample snippet: `usage_window: 2026-03-20T00:00:00Z`, `tier_applied: "pro-100k"`, `soft_limit_used: 102340`, `grace_applied: false`
Eve (Docs): This will need a docs note either way. If grace windows are not applied during snapshots we should call out the caveat under "Billing snapshots" and link the FAQ.
Nina (Product): Is this affecting customer-visible invoices or just internal previews?
Leo (Billing): A few invoice previews went live; small number of customers saw a +1-2% delta. Not full invoices yet but could confuse CS.
Sam (SDK): If the snapshot API doesn't apply grace, folks using our SDK examples that rely on `billing.preview()` could see different numbers than the live dashboard. We should update the SDK snippet to recommend `use_live=true` for small accounts or mention the caveat.
Ana (Analytics): I can run a quick delta query across the last 7 days to scope impacted accounts. Will post results in ~30m.
docs-bot: New PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5148 — "billing: note snapshot grace window caveat" (Eve).
Eve (Docs): Thanks @docs-bot. Draft change is tiny — one paragraph under /docs/platform/billing/snapshots and an SDK snippet change in /docs/sdk/usage_examples.md
Ravi (Backend): Putting a quick patch on the snapshot job to ensure grace windows are applied during aggregation. I'll open an ops PR and tag @Leo and @Eve. If the fix is small we can roll it in today.
Leo (Billing): Please do. Also can we add a debug flag that forces `grace_applied=true` in the preview path so CS can reproduce?
Ravi (Backend): Yep, adding `?force_grace=true` to the preview endpoint. Will document endpoint behavior in the API reference too.
Eve (Docs): Action items: (1) I'll update the snapshot caveat paragraph and add an inline SDK example that shows `billing.preview({use_live: true})` with a short note. (2) Update API ref to show `force_grace` query param. (3) Link to PRs: backend and docs in the change log. Anyone want to review the wording?
Nina (Product): I'll do a quick wording pass — want it framed to reduce CS churn. Keep it clear: "Preview numbers may differ from invoices if snapshots haven't applied grace windows yet"
Sam (SDK): I'll adjust the Node + Python snippets and add a one-line comment explaining the difference. PR incoming: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/903
Ana (Analytics): Quick FYI — delta scope looks like ~12 accounts over last 7 days, mostly small mid-market. Posting list to #support in 10m.
Eve (Docs): Cool. I'll wait for Ravi's backend PR link and then open docs PR 5148 for review. Tagging reviewers: @Sam (SDK), @Nina (Product), @Leo (Billing).
Ravi (Backend): Backend PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/3217 — fixes aggregation, adds `force_grace` preview flag. Rolling to staging now.
Leo (Billing): Thanks. Once staging confirms I'll coordinate a short customer comms note and CS playbook. :white_check_mark:
Eve (Docs): Merged draft to staging docs branch. Leaving a small example block: ```js
// recommended for invoice-accurate previews
await billing.preview({ use_live: true })
```
Eve (Docs): Final nit — Nina, should we mention any policy around when grace windows expire (e.g., prorate behavior)?
Nina (Product): Yes please, add a short FAQ bullet: "Grace windows are applied only at invoice time and may not be reflected in intermediate snapshots; prorates happen at month boundary."
Eve (Docs): Done. I'll ship PR after backend is green. Thanks everyone :rocket:
